title: Devtool configuration
description: A devtool configuration file: config.yml, config.local.yml or any file they include.

workspace.description: Folder holding your repositories. Relative section paths are resolved from it. Usually personal, in config.local.yml.

sectionPath.description: Path, from the workspace, of the sections that declare no path.

include.description: Other configuration files to merge over this one, relative to this file. Globs, ~/ and $VAR work.

loadBalancers.description: TLS certificates served by the load balancer, by domain. The certificate of a domain also covers its subdomains.

passthrough.description: TLS connections forwarded untouched by their server name, for tools serving their own certificates.

integrations.description: Web tools shown under Environment and Configs in the sidebar.

sections.description: Groups of projects shown in the sidebar, by slug.

projects.description: Projects (folders) with their commands, services, files and integrations, by slug.

access.description: Who may connect: local (this machine only) or network (any client of the network).

args.description: The command and its arguments; an item may be an input asked when the command starts. Empty: an interactive shell.

input.description: An input asked when the command starts: one of choices, a flag or free text.

name.description: Label of the input; a flag adds it to the command when ticked.

optional.description: A choice may be left empty.

flag.description: A checkbox adding the name when ticked.

text.description: Free text, split like a shell does.

default.description: Value filled in: one of the choices, a boolean for a flag, a text.

match.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the output.

value.description: Text typed when it matches. Value blocks are read.

opAccount.description: 1Password account (ID or sign-in address) used to read op:// value blocks.

unless.description: A check run first; its success skips the command.

answers.description: Answers typed when the output matches, each once, in order.

restore.description: Command run in the parent folder to bring back a missing folder. %{ADT:PATH} stands for the missing folder.

icon.description: An Iconify name (prefix:name); a bare name gets the lucide: prefix.

killSignal.description: Signal sent to stop the command.

env.description: Environment variables, as a map or a list of maps merged in order. Value blocks are read in commands.

mcpLevel.description: allow, ask (a dialog in the interface), deny, or keys (files only: keys and value types, never values).

mcpRules.description: Agent permission: one level for every action, or levels by action.

level.description: Level of what no pattern matches.

deny.description: Patterns denied; deny wins over allow.

displayName.description: Name shown in the tab, the sidebar, the notifications and the macOS app.

name.description: Identifier of the MCP server and the macOS app. Default: the display name in lowercase.

icon.description: Icon file (SVG, PNG, JPEG or ICNS), relative to the configuration folder.

cacheDir.description: Folder of what the devtool rebuilds or keeps between runs. Given to commands as APPSYS_DEVTOOL_CACHE_DIR.

host.description: Host name serving the interface through the load balancer.

access.description: Who may open the interface through adt.host.

server.description: Port of the server and the interface, on 127.0.0.1.

loadBalancer.description: Port of the load balancer, on every interface.

shell.description: Default shell of the commands. Default: $SHELL.

notifications.description: Notify when a command ends; the default of every section, project and command.

environment.description: Show the link to the Environment page.

configs.description: Show the link to the Configs page.

login.description: Show the sign-in state of the identity provider.

sort.description: Order of the sections, and default order of their content.

order.description: With sort: manual, the section slugs shown first.

agents.description: Coding agents started by the agent buttons of pull requests and issues.

args.description: Run in a terminal of the project. %{ADT:PROMPT} and %{ADT:CWD} are replaced.

url.description: Opened by the browser. %{ADT:PROMPT} and %{ADT:CWD} are replaced, URL-encoded.

agentPrompts.description: Prompts of the agent actions, by kind of integration.

mcp.description: The MCP server agents connect to, and what they may do.

enabled.description: Answer MCP clients of this machine at http://127.0.0.1:<adt.ports.server>/mcp.

notifications.description: Notify when an agent asks for permission. Default: adt.notifications.

skills.description: Serve the agent skills of the devtool over MCP (Skills extension).

timeout.description: Seconds before an unanswered request is refused.

ownTerminals.description: Typing into and controlling the terminals an agent started itself.

default.description: Levels every other setting inherits. Default: read allow, everything else ask.

terminals.description: Terminals a person opened without a command.

integrations.description: list_pull_requests and list_issues (read), refined by the sections, projects and integrations.

clients.description: Which agents may connect. Default level: ask.

shell.description: Shell commands of run_shell. Default level: deny.

crt.description: Certificate: a file (relative to the configuration folder) or PEM text.

key.description: Private key: a file or PEM text.

warn.description: Days before the expiry from which the Server page warns.

acme.description: Renewal of the certificate, by lego or by your own command. crt and key must be files.

trigger.description: Renew from the Server page, on its own, or both.

before.description: Days before the expiry from which auto renews.

lego.description: Options of lego run, without their dashes: a value gives --name value, a list repeats it, true gives it alone.

command.description: Your renewal command, run in the folder of the certificate. %{ADT:CRT} and %{ADT:KEY} are replaced.

dns.description: Local DNS server answering your own names, every other name resolved by its upstream server or the system.

enabled.description: Run the DNS; false in config.local.yml turns off a DNS of the shared configuration.

upstream.description: DNS server resolving the names without a record, <host>[:<port>] (port 53 by default), such as another devtool's DNS; the system's resolver when missing.

address.description: An IPv4 address, or auto for the current address of this machine.

auth.description: The identity provider signing the developers in, for the cdn backends and the {{ auth://... }} value blocks.

name.description: Name of the identity provider shown in the sign-in texts.

clientId.description: Public client of the devtool at the issuer.

callbackPort.description: Local port the issuer redirects to: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback.

scopes.description: Scopes asked at sign-in; add email to read {{ auth://email }}.

url.description: web: the page shown. pullRequests and issues: the repository, its origin remote by default.

embed.description: Show the page inside the devtool; false opens a new tab.

provider.description: The forge, guessed from github.* and gitlab.* hosts.

token.description: Access token of the forge. Value blocks are read.

refresh.description: Minutes between two reads, 0 to read from the button only.

badge.description: Count in the sidebar the pull requests waiting for your review, or the issues assigned to you.

agentReview.description: pullRequests: a Review button starting an agent.

agentAnalyze.description: issues: a button asking an agent for a plan.

agentFix.description: issues: a button asking an agent to fix the issue on its own branch.

mcp.description: pullRequests and issues: whether agents may read its items (read). Default: adt.mcp.integrations, then the section and the project.

path.description: Folder of the section, relative to the workspace. Default: sectionPath.

icons.description: Integrations shown as icons in the header of the section.

lines.description: Integrations shown as rows under the header of the section.

sort.description: Order of the content. Default: adt.sidebar.sort.

order.description: With sort: manual, project slugs and rows (integration:<slug>) shown first.

section.description: Slug of the section holding the project.

path.description: Folder of the project, relative to its section. Default: the slug.

env.description: Environment of the commands, scripts and terminals of the project; a command's own env wins.

icons.description: Shortcuts shown as icons at the right of the project row.

lines.description: Shortcuts shown as rows under the project.

action.description: What the project does by default; command:<slug> becomes its main command.

trigger.description: From a button on the row, a click on the row, or both.

icon.description: Icon of the button: an Iconify name, or own for the icon of the integration.

env.description: Environment variables, added on top of the env of the project.

detached.description: Run without a terminal; value blocks and unless are not read.

prompt.description: Run in the background and show its questions in a dialog, instead of opening its terminal.

startWithSection.description: Start when the section is started from its header.

commandForm.description: Where the inputs are asked on the project page: in a dialog, in the row unfolded on click, or in the row unfolded from the start.

path.description: Folder of executables, relative to the project.

only.description: Glob patterns of the file names kept.

target.description: Where requests go: a local port, <host>:<port> or an http(s) URL; a list shares the requests in turn.

tls.description: Tell the target the request came over HTTPS (x-forwarded-proto).

path.description: Only requests whose path starts with it; the longest path wins.

pathNot.description: Requests whose path starts with it are left out.

prefix.description: Removed from the path before forwarding.

path.description: Folder, relative to the project. It may not exist yet.

type.description: agentSkills edits one agent skill per folder.

showHidden.description: Show the files and folders whose name starts with a dot (.env, .github...); .git is never shown.

mcpSkills.description: agentSkills: serve its skills over MCP (Skills extension), all of them with true or the skill folders matching globs.

restore.description: Slug of a command of the project restoring the folder.

commands.description: Slugs of commands of the project shown with the files.

pull.description: Pull this item on its own while the server runs.

encryption.description: Encrypts the files before they reach the backend: a key (32 bytes in base64), a password (stretched with scrypt), or a password asked when needed. key and password read value blocks.

key.description: 32 bytes in base64, such as the output of openssl rand -base64 32.

prompt.description: Ask the password when a file is unlocked: in the terminal for the CLI, in a dialog of the interface for the server.

backendName.description: Name of a backend of environment.backends; the default backend when omitted.

default.description: Items naming no backend, and the shared configuration, use this one; the first backend when none is marked.

backend.description: Where files of the environment are stored.

type.description: A CDN serving the devtool files API, reached with the access token of the auth section.

url.description: Base URL of the CDN; files live under <url>/devtool/.

type.description: An S3 bucket, on AWS or any S3 compatible service.

prefix.description: Prefix of the keys of the files.

endpoint.description: Address of an S3 compatible service; AWS when omitted.

accessKeyId.description: Value blocks are read; the default AWS credentials when omitted.

pathStyle.description: Address the bucket in the path, as MinIO and others expect.

path.description: Folder of the files on the server.

privateKey.description: Private key file, ~/ allowed; else the password, else the SSH agent.

passphrase.description: Passphrase of the private key; value blocks are read.

type.description: A git repository, each push a commit, read and written with the git of the machine.

url.description: Address of the repository, as git clone takes it.

path.description: Folder of the files in the repository; its root when omitted.

type.description: Your own commands, for any storage the other backends do not reach.

cwd.description: Folder the commands run in, relative to the configuration folder.

download.description: Writes %{ADT:PATH} to %{ADT:FILE}; exits 2 when the file does not exist.

env.description: Environment variables of the commands; value blocks are read.

encryptionRule.description: Encrypts the items whose path matches one of the patterns; the first matching rule wins, the encryption of an item overrides the rules.

paths.description: Glob patterns of item paths, such as secrets/** or **/*.env.

environment.description: The development environment shared through its backends.

backends.description: Where the files are stored, by name; items choose theirs with backend.

encryption.description: Encryption of the items by path pattern.

folder.description: Local mirror of the files of the backends. Default: the parent of the configuration folder.

display.description: List it in the Configs tab.

ignore.description: Keys of a YAML, JSON, TOML, XML or .env file left out of its synchronization, each copy keeping its own values: dotted paths where * stands for one key or list index and ** for any depth.

path.description: Archive of the database in the environment folder.
Snapshot of the bucket in the environment folder.
Dump of the Redis database in the environment folder.
